messages:
maria: Hey team, opening a short PR to add an example for collecting installer logs from an on-prem air-gapped install behind an internal proxy/load-balancer. The current docs only show systemd journal commands and that's not enough for customers that have a sidecar proxy capturing traffic.
kevin: SGTM — can you add a small troubleshooting section with the two things we always ask: 1) where to pull the collector bundle, 2) how to capture env + certs without leaking secrets?
maria: Yep. Drafting now. Planning to include a tiny helper script and a config snippet for the 'redwood-collector' service that runs on the bootstrap node.
raj: For context, customers often run a TCP LB that terminates TLS and then forward via PROXY protocol. We should call out X-Forwarded-For vs PROXY v1 header differences.
sylvia: Also mention the airgap case where the collector needs an explicit proxy CA bundle mount. I had a support case where logs failed because the collector couldn't reach the local artifact server due to missing /etc/ca-certificates/extra.
maria: Good catches. Proposed content to add to docs PR: 1) Example collector.service unit, 2) small bash helper to tar logs + redact tokens, 3) example proxy CA mount snippet, 4) note about PROXY protocol vs X-Forwarded-For.
kevin: Can you paste the unit + script here so I can sanity check? Keep it small — 4-6 lines for the systemd unit is enough.
maria: Pasted below. If it's too long I can keep only the essentials.

```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-collector.service
[Unit]
Description=Redwood installer log collector
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-collect.sh /var/log/redwood /tmp/redwood-logs.tgz

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

```
#!/bin/bash
# /usr/local/bin/redwood-collect.sh <logdir> <out>
set -euo pipefail
LOGDIR=${1:-/var/log/redwood}
OUT=${2:-/tmp/redwood-logs.tgz}
# redact tokens
find "$LOGDIR" -type f -name "*.log" -exec sed -E 's/(token|secret)=[A-Za-z0-9-_]+/\1=[REDACTED]/g' {} \; | tar -czf "$OUT" -T -
# include certs and env but strip private keys
cp -r /etc/redwood/certs /tmp/certs || true
find /tmp/certs -type f -name "*.key" -delete
```

raj: Two quick suggestions: 1) the sed+tar pipeline above reads files into sed and then expects tar -T - (which wants filenames). Might be simpler to create a temp dir, copy redacted files there, then tar. 2) call out that this script must be run as root or with sudo to access /var/log/redwood and certs.
sylvia: Also add example for mounting proxy CA in offline installer values.yaml for airgap customers. Something like: 

```
# values.yaml snippet
collector:
  extraCerts:
    - name: internal-proxy-ca.crt
      mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/internal-proxy-ca.pem
```

kevin: Nice. Add a short bullet about proxy headers: if LB uses PROXY protocol v1, include `proxy_protocol: "v1"` in the loadbalancer config and the installer will preserve client ip. If the LB sets X-Forwarded-For, ensure your ingress/nginx has `use-forwarded-headers: true`.
maria: I'll add both notes and a small troubleshooting checklist: 
- Collector fails to connect to artifact server: check proxy CA mount and /etc/resolv.conf
- Logs missing auth context: verify collector ran as root or sudo
- Client IP wrong: inspect whether LB uses PROXY protocol vs X-Forwarded-For and follow the corresponding config snippet

docs-bot: Reminder: link check scheduled. If you add files under docs/assets/ make sure the CI uploads them to the airgap bundle.
kevin: One more ask — include an example curl to upload the tarball to support with a presigned URL and an instruction to avoid pasting the URL publicly. Example: `curl -T /tmp/redwood-logs.tgz "$PRESIGNED_URL" --insecure` (note: explain why --insecure may be needed in airgap test labs).
maria: Will do. I'll open the PR in about 30m and drop the link here. tagging @sylvia for cert wording and @raj for PROXY protocol wording. :thumbsup:
raj: I'll review once it's up, focusing on the loadbalancer section.
sylvia: LGTM in principle, will double-check CA mount language.
kevin: Thanks — this will save a lot of back-and-forth with support. :rocket:
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — small change set, added collector example, values.yaml snippet, and troubleshooting bullets. Please review.
kevin: Reviewing now.

sylvia: Left one suggestion to soften wording around cert copying to avoid encouraging PEM copying.
